tasks.short: Review logistics reports for efficiency and environmental impact.

steps.what: Review the global or national logistics reports and mark each source.
List figures in the report that name a table or a date.
Match those figures to lanes already in the operations log.
Judge which findings minimize impact or improve efficiency.
Drop an environmental impact claim that has no source in the report.
File the review note with the kept citations only.

tasks.design: The analyst reviews the report and marks each source. Only figures that name a table or a date are listed and matched to lanes. A claim with no source in the report is dropped before the note is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review notes repeated a report's conclusion and cited nothing.
tasks.enabler_now: A figure that already names a table and a date can be listed.
tasks.still_hard: A report the analyst has not read is not reviewed.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst can say which finding applies to these lanes and which is someone else's network.
tasks.altitude: Reading and judging the report stay. Lifting labeled figures does not.

reach.task: Use or ignore a kept finding
reach.learn: Which claim was dropped because the report gave it no source

evidence.claim: A figure with a table and a date can be listed. A report the analyst has not read is not reviewed.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from a report the analyst has opened to a note that keeps only sourced claims. Publishing a new study is out of scope.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are report title, source mark, figure table, and figure date. Fallback: a sentence with no table or date is not listed as a figure.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is amplify. Listing labeled figures is that gain. The review itself stays. The note must not invent a citation.
unknowns: Whether this report's figures may be copied into an internal note.
research_questions: How often a striking claim in the report has no table or date.

incremental.description: Drop reports that have been superseded

approvals.approved_version: review note that keeps only sourced claims

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Extracting labeled figures is saved. Reading the report and judging findings stay. The low case is a report whose figures have no source line.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess the environmental impact or energy efficiency of logistics activities, using carbon mitigation software.

steps.what: Export logistics activities the carbon software accepts.
Run the carbon mitigation software and keep its log.
Assess whether that result is a fair environmental impact.
Sign the energy efficiency assessment and leave a blank factor.

tasks.design: Activity rows the carbon software already accepts are exported from {ERP}. The analyst runs the software, keeps the log, and assesses whether the result is a fair impact. A factor the customer has not confirmed stays blank. The signature is that assessment, not the software total.
tasks.previous_blocker: Software totals were pasted into a note and treated as the assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: The export the software already accepts can be produced from {ERP} without a new feed.
tasks.still_hard: A total is not an assessment of energy efficiency or environmental impact.
tasks.human_edge: The analyst knows which activity the factor does not fit.
tasks.altitude: The assessment and the signature stay. The export shrinks. Running the existing software stays a short check.

reach.task: Accept or query the signed assessment
reach.learn: Which factor was left blank and why the total was not signed as-is

evidence.claim: A carbon tool can total rows it is given. The assessment of that total is a separate judgement.

assumptions: Focal role is the logistics analyst. Boundary: from an accepted export and a software log to a signed assessment. Choosing the factor set is the customer's act.
Test the existing {ERP} or {OPS_SYSTEM} view before a custom extract.
Structured fields are activity id, the export column the software already accepts, and the log id. Fallback: a factor the customer has not confirmed is left blank.
EU data-protection rules apply. A feed that names a person is monitoring and needs works-council consent where national rules require it.
The prior class is human. The graph agrees. The software run is not the assessment.
unknowns: Which factor set the carbon software is allowed to use.
research_questions: How often the analyst leaves the software total unsigned.

incremental.description: Re-check the export columns when the software changes what it accepts

approvals.approved_version: assessment signed after the software log was read

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Exporting accepted rows is partly saved. The assessment stays with the analyst. The low case is a factor the customer has not confirmed, which stays blank.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reading a report and assessing a carbon total stay with the analyst. Lifting a labeled figure does not.
reach: Planning leads, on which report claim was dropped for lack of a source.
Environmental coordinators, on which factor was left blank.
skills_to_grow: Leaving a citation out when the report did not give one.
Signing an assessment only after reading the software log.
role.ambitious_version: A review note quotes only a figure that names its table, and a carbon note shows the log it was judged against.
